# Hyprdrive configuration keys

**Generated by `scripts/gen_keys_table.sh` from `Config.cpp`. Do not edit.**
Regenerate after adding or changing a key; `--check` fails if this file is stale.

Every key lives under `plugin:hyprdrive:`. 185 keys.

**Compatibility.** The plugin was called `scrolloverview`; every key is
also registered under the old `plugin:scrolloverview:` prefix and a value set
there is copied onto the new name at config reload (the new name wins if
both are set). The old spelling prints one deprecation warning per session
and is removed one release after the rename.

## General

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gesture_distance` | int | `200` | >= 1 | gesture distance in pixels |
| `gesture_detent` | float | `0.35` | 0 .. 0.9 | magnetic detent strength on the 3-finger workspace drag; 0 = linear |
| `gesture_detent_label` | int | `1` | 0 .. 1 | show the workspace name pill on the card the workspace drag is settling on |
| `gesture_detent_sound` | string | `"~/.local/bin/keystroke-click"` |  | executable run once per workspace boundary crossed during the drag; empty = silent, missing file = silent |
| `col_highlight` | color/gradient | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)` |  | colour of the selection/hover highlights; unset falls back to general:col.active_border |
| `scale` | float | `0.82` | 0.1 .. 0.9 | overview scale |
| `anim_scale` | float | `1` | 0 .. 100 | global animation slowdown; 1 = normal, 10 = ten times slower, 0 = snap |
| `open_speed` | float | `2.6` | 0.1 .. 20 | overview open duration, tenths of a second |
| `close_speed` | float | `1.9` | 0.1 .. 20 | overview close duration, tenths of a second |
| `workspace_gap` | int | `40` | >= 0 | gap between overview workspaces |
| `layout` | string | `"vertical"` |  | overview layout |
| `terminal` | string | `""` |  | terminal used to launch Terminal=true desktop entries; empty falls back to $TERMINAL |
| `drag_mini_scale` | float | `0.45` | 0.05 .. 1 | size of the drag proxy while it hovers another workspace, as a fraction of its tile size |
| `drag_mini_ms` | int | `150` | >= 0 | ms for the drag proxy to shrink to, or grow back from, mini scale |
| `drag_recentre_ms` | int | `160` | >= 0 | ms for the drag proxy's grab point to slide to its centre while over a drop target |
| `wallpaper` | int | `0` | 0 .. 2 | wallpaper mode |
| `blur` | bool | `false` |  | unused: see plugin:hyprdrive:backdrop |
| `backdrop` | string | `"snapshot"` |  | what the overview blurs behind the desktop cards: off (the wallpaper darkened, no blur), wallpaper (the static wallpaper), snapshot (a live wallpaper, frozen as the overview opens), live (re-blurred as it moves), auto (live while it changes rarely, snapshot while it animates) |
| `focus_follows_pick` | bool | `false` |  | with several monitors, closing the overview leaves focus and the pointer where you picked, instead of on another monitor's selected window |
| `layout_motion_blur` | int | `16` | 0 .. 32 | motion blur samples while the layout moves or resizes a window -- a dwindle retile, the scrolling tape, a window opening (0 = off); never an interactive drag |
| `live_layer_frost` | bool | `true` |  | evaluate dock/bar frost against the overview backdrop instead of the stale optimized blur FB |
| `smooth_frames` | bool | `false` |  | render ahead when the GPU runs late: holds render:new_render_scheduling on for the session and restores yours when off; a late frame then costs one refresh, not half the frame rate |
| `prefilter_below` | float | `0.55` | 0 .. 1 | mipmap-prefilter a tile's texture when it is minified below this fraction (0 = never) |
| `mission_control` | bool | `true` |  | lay the focused workspace out as a mission-control grid |
| `mission_control_gap` | int | `40` | >= 0 | gap between mission-control grid tiles |
| `mission_control_reflow_ms` | int | `300` | >= 0 | ms for a grid tile to travel to a new slot |
| `overview_tile_order` | string | `"recent"` |  | the order of the overview grid's tiles, top left to bottom right: recent (the most recently used window first), created (the order the windows were opened) or position (as the windows sit on the desktop); taken as the overview opens |
| `strip` | bool | `true` |  | workspace thumbnail strip across the top of the overview |
| `strip_height` | int | `260` | >= 0 | logical px the strip band reserves at the top of the workspace |
| `strip_max_screen_pct` | int | `30` | 1 .. 100 | ceiling on the strip band as a percent of screen height, so a strip cell never dwarfs a window preview |
| `strip_gap` | int | `5` | >= 0 | gap between strip cells |
| `strip_cleanup_button` | bool | `true` |  | hold Super over the overview's desktop strip: a Clean Up Empty Desktops button under it removes that monitor's empty desktops between the others |
| `tap_super` | bool | `true` |  | tapping SUPER alone toggles the overview |
| `tap_super_timeout_ms` | int | `250` | >= 0 | longest press-to-release still counted as a SUPER tap (0 = no limit) |

## `dock`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:dock:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: draw the dock |
| `icon_size` | int | `54` | 8 .. 512 | hyprgnomedock: max icon size (dash-max-icon-size) |
| `height_fraction` | float | `0.90` | 0.05 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: max fraction of the monitor's long axis the dock may span |
| `corner_radius` | int | `24` | >= 0 | hyprgnomedock: pill corner radius |
| `minimize_ms` | int | `400` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: minimize/restore flight duration, 0 to teleport (Y5: GNOME's MINIMIZE_WINDOW_ANIMATION_TIME) |

| `hide_over_fullscreen` | bool | `false` |  | the dock keeps away while any fullscreen window is shown |
| `hide_over_games` | bool | `true` |  | the dock keeps away while a fullscreen game or the screensaver is shown (implied by hide_over_fullscreen) |
| `pressure_threshold` | float | `100` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: px of motion pushed into the bottom edge before the dock reveals (D2D pressure-threshold) |
| `require_pressure` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: the bottom edge must be PUSHED past pressure_threshold, not merely touched (D2D require-pressure-to-show) |
| `show_delay_ms` | int | `250` | 0 .. 5000 | hyprgnomedock: delay from the barrier trigger to the reveal (D2D show-delay) |
| `hide_delay_ms` | int | `200` | 0 .. 5000 | hyprgnomedock: delay from the pointer leaving to the hide (D2D hide-delay) |
| `autohide_ms` | int | `200` | 0 .. 2000 | hyprgnomedock: slide duration (D2D animation-time) |

| `indicator_size` | int | `5` | 1 .. 64 | hyprgnomedock: running-dot diameter in px |
| `notification_counter` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: red count badge on the icon (D2D show-icons-notifications-counter) |
| `emblems` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: draw Unity LauncherEntry emblems at all (D2D show-icons-emblems) |
| `hover_tilt` | bool | `true` |  | dock icons lean toward the pointer in 3D while hovered, and spring flat on leave |
| `menu_animation` | bool | `true` |  | the dock's context menu grows out of its icon and collapses back, like the search results |
| `menu_anim_ms` | int | `180` | 0 .. 2000 | the dock context menu's expand time in ms (its collapse is ~25% shorter); scaled by anim_scale |
| `press_tilt` | bool | `true` |  | a pressed dock icon leans further in toward the press point, with a glare where it is pressed |
| `dance_urgent` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: wiggle an urgent app's icon (D2D dance-urgent-applications) |
| `urgent_notify` | bool | `true` |  | an urgent app's icon hops up from the screen edge while the dock is hidden (it no longer reveals the dock) |
| `flight_log` | bool | `false` |  | flight lifecycle log to $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/ovdbg.log, for scripts/z_rig.sh + zflight_gate.py |
| `show_favorites` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: pinned apps in the dock whether running or not (D2D show-favorites) |
| `show_apps_button` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: the Show Applications button (D2D show-show-apps-button) |
| `show_apps_at_top` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: Show Applications at the START of the dock (D2D show-apps-at-top) |
| `show_apps_always_in_the_edge` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: keep Show Applications hard against the dock's edge (D2D show-apps-always-in-the-edge) |
| `show_apps_icon` | string | `"view-app-grid-symbolic"` |  | hyprgnomedock: Show Applications artwork |
| `pointer_to_window` | bool | `true` |  | dock: clicking a window preview, or Ctrl+clicking an app, puts the pointer on the middle of the window it brings forward (a plain click on an app leaves the pointer on the dock) |
| `scroll_action` | string | `"cycle-windows"` |  | hyprgnomedock: wheel over the dock: cycle-windows | switch-workspace | do-nothing (D2D scroll-action) |
| `middle_click_action` | string | `"launch"` |  | hyprgnomedock: middle click on an icon: launch | minimize | cycle-windows | quit | skip (D2D middle-click-action) |
| `shift_middle_click_action` | string | `"launch"` |  | hyprgnomedock: shift+middle click on an icon (D2D shift-middle-click-action) |
| `isolate_workspaces` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: the dock lists only windows on the current workspace (D2D isolate-workspaces) |
| `isolate_in_overview` | bool | `false` |  | while the overview is open, the dock lists only windows on the current workspace (isolate_workspaces does it everywhere) |
| `monitor` | string | `""` |  | draw the dock on one monitor only: its name (DP-1) or desc:<description prefix>; empty = every monitor. A monitor that is not connected falls back to every monitor |
| `workspace_agnostic_urgent` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: an urgent window stays listed even when isolate_workspaces hides its workspace (D2D workspace-agnostic-urgent-windows) |

| `hotkeys_overlay` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a hotkey press draws the slot numbers on the icons (D2D hotkeys-overlay) |
| `hotkeys_show_dock` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a hotkey press reveals a hidden dock while the overlay is up (D2D hotkeys-show-dock) |

| `folders_anywhere` | bool | `false` |  | dock stacks: folders can be dragged anywhere among the apps (off: they sit together after the apps; drives, the Trash and Show Overview stay last either way) |
| `show_trash` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a Trash item at the end of the dock (D2D show-trash) |
| `show_mounts` | bool | `false` |  | hyprgnomedock: mounted volumes as dock items (D2D show-mounts) |
| `show_mounts_network` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: include network shares among the mounts (D2D show-mounts-network) |
| `show_mounts_only_mounted` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: only volumes that are mounted, not every one present (D2D show-mounts-only-mounted) |
| `mount_sort` | string | `"mounted"` |  | dock: the mounted drives' order -- mounted (as they were mounted), name (alphabetical, numbers as numbers), smart (name, reading spelled-out and Roman numbers too: KleOne, KleTwo, KleThree) or fstab (their order in /etc/fstab; unlisted drives after) |
| `isolate_locations` | bool | `true` |  | hyprgnomedock: a location's running state is its own, not the file manager's (D2D isolate-locations) |
| `stack_motion_blur` | int | `8` | 0 .. 32 | dock stacks: motion blur samples while the fan moves (0 = off); each frame averages this many instants |
| `windows_make_room` | bool | `true` |  | dock: with autohide off, tiled windows that would sit under the dock are shortened to clear it (only those in the way) |
| `minimize_motion_blur` | int | `16` | 0 .. 32 | dock: motion blur samples while a window flies into / out of its icon (0 = off), desktop and overview alike |
| `stack_motion` | string | `"serpantinum"` |  | dock stacks: the fan's motion -- serpantinum (OutQuint travel, OutBack pop, 40 ms stagger) or extension (dock-stacks' 140 ms ease-out-quad) |
| `builtin_icons` | bool | `true` |  | dock stacks: hyprdrive's own empty-stack artwork (false = the folder icon) |
| `stack_icon_theme` | string | `"omarchy"` |  | dock stacks: icon theme for stacks and their files -- omarchy (the current Omarchy theme's icons) or gtk |
| `trash_icon` | string | `"hyprdrive"` |  | dock: the Trash's icon -- hyprdrive (its own artwork), omarchy or gtk |
| `trash_style` | string | `"auto"` |  | dock: hyprdrive Trash glass -- auto (follows the theme), light, dark or clear |
| `trash_papers` | string | `"white"` |  | dock: what fills hyprdrive's full Trash -- white or color |
| `background_color` | color | `0` |  | hyprgnomedock: pill hue (alpha 0 = Omarchy terminal background, else misc:background_color; opacity is background_opacity) |
| `background_opacity` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: pill alpha (-1 = Omarchy default-opacity) |
| `blur_size` | int | `-1` | -1 .. 64 | hyprgnomedock: blur size (-1 = follow decoration:blur:size) |
| `blur_passes` | int | `-1` | -1 .. 10 | hyprgnomedock: blur passes (-1 = follow decoration:blur:passes) |
| `blur_brightness` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 2 | hyprgnomedock: blur brightness (blur-my-shell brightness; -1 = follow decoration:blur:brightness) |
| `blur_noise` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: blur grain; the reference has none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:noise) |
| `blur_contrast` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 2 | hyprgnomedock: blur contrast; the reference applies none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:contrast) |
| `blur_vibrancy` | float | `-1` | -1 .. 1 | hyprgnomedock: blur vibrancy; the reference applies none (-1 = follow decoration:blur:vibrancy) |

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:search:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dictionary` | bool | `false` |  | `define <word>` in the overview search looks the word up on Wiktionary (sends the word to en.wiktionary.org) |
| `browse_on_click` | bool | `false` |  | clicking the overview's search pill with nothing typed opens the results: the menu, folder shortcuts and AI & Tools rows |
| `easter_egg` | bool | `false` |  | overview search: type a letter and backspace five times in four seconds and the pill plays search:easter_egg_video (off unless you turn it on) |

| `translate_endpoint` | string | `""` |  | LibreTranslate-compatible base URL for `tr`; empty uses the free MyMemory API |
| `translate_target` | string | `""` |  | language `translate <text>` translates into when none is given; empty uses $LANG |

## `general`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:general:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fullscreen_desktop` | string | `"next"` |  | where an app going fullscreen goes: next (a desktop of its own right after yours; the ones after move along), free (the next free desktop) or stay (where it is). An app alone on its desktop stays in any case |
| `file_manager` | string | `""` |  | the file manager folders open in: a desktop entry such as org.kde.dolphin.desktop, or empty for the system's default for folders |
| `scratchpad_bar_exit` | bool | `true` |  | while a scratchpad is shown, stripe the bar with 'hover to exit scratchpad' and hide the scratchpad on a dwell there |
| `text_size` | string | `"default"` |  | Hyprdrive's text size: default (its own sizes), system (Omarchy's [font] base-size in shell.toml; 12 = the default) or custom (general:text_scale) |
| `text_scale` | float | `1` | 0.7 .. 1.15 | the text size used when general:text_size is custom; 1 = Hyprdrive's own sizes |
| `open_tiled` | bool | `false` |  | windows float only when you float them: a window the app opens floating (a dialog, a fixed-size window, Wine and Proton's too) is tiled, on every desktop -- Mosaic desktops always do this; float rules, the hyprdrive-float tag, splash screens and tool palettes still float |

## `mosaic`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:mosaic:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | bool | `false` |  | mosaic: Super+L cycles Dwindle -> Scrolling -> Mosaic (the panel asks before turning it on) |
| `default` | bool | `false` |  | mosaic: new desktops use the Mosaic layout (needs mosaic:enabled) |
| `infinite_canvas` | bool | `false` |  | mosaic: windows that no longer fit the screen spill onto a canvas you pan across, at their own sizes, instead of tiling |
| `quiet_new_windows` | bool | `true` |  | mosaic: a window you did not open (a loading screen, an app reopening itself) opens without taking the focus, and the pointer stays on your window |
| `spawn_at_cursor` | bool | `true` |  | mosaic: a new window opens where the pointer is, the others packed around it, on the mosaic and the infinite canvas |
| `edge_push` | bool | `true` |  | mosaic: on the infinite canvas, pushing the pointer firmly against a screen edge slides the canvas to show the windows hidden past it |
| `edge_push_resistance` | int | `400` | 50 .. 1500 | mosaic: how far (px) the pointer must keep pushing into the edge before the canvas gives way (the bottom edge, where the dock is, takes half again as much); lower = easier |
| `canvas_directions` | string | `"all"` |  | mosaic: the infinite canvas grows horizontal (a strip) or all (a grid); on either, hold Super and move the pointer to zoom out to every window, hover one to focus it, let go of Super to zoom back in |
| `canvas_super_move` | string | `"zoom"` |  | mosaic: retired and ignored (holding Super on the canvas always zooms out) |
| `zoom_labels` | string | `"hover"` |  | window titles while Super is held and the pointer moves, on any desktop (the zoomed-out canvas too): none, hover (the window under the pointer) or all |

## `animation`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:animation:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `curve` | string | `"hyprdrive"` |  | the curve family for everything hyprdrive animates except the dock stacks: hyprdrive (the house curves), serpantinum (its window curve), serpantinum_glide, serpantinum_soft, serpantinum_intro, serpantinum_pop, swift, springy, linear |
| `canvas_curve` | string | `"hyprdrive"` |  | the infinite canvas's pans and zoom: a curve family as animation:curve names them (its travel curve); hyprdrive (the house curve, no overshoot) by default |
| `canvas_pan_ms` | int | `420` | 0 .. 2000 | the infinite canvas's pans and zoom, in ms (scaled by anim_scale; 0 = instant) |
| `desktop_keyboard` | bool | `true` |  | animate desktop changes a key or scroll bind makes (Super+1..0, Super+Tab, Super+scroll, move window to a desktop); false = instant. Gates Hyprland's workspaces animation, so nothing to do while that is off |
| `desktop_focus` | bool | `true` |  | animate desktop changes made by focus moving to a window on another desktop (app activation, a dock or notification click, focuswindow); false = instant |
| `desktop_row_bounce` | bool | `true` |  | the row of desktops stretches a little past its first and last desktop and springs back |
| `desktop_jump_through` | bool | `false` |  | a key or dock jump of several desktops (Super+5 from desktop 1) slides through the desktops between |

## `binds`

Prefix: `plugin:hyprdrive:binds:`

| key | type | default | range | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scroll_desktops` | bool | `true` |  | <mods> + wheel moves through desktops by number, empty ones included, no wrap -- the row of desktops slides with the wheel; replaces Omarchy's Super+scroll |
| `scroll_desktops_mods` | string | `"SUPER"` |  | modifiers for binds:scroll_desktops, as a bind spells them (SUPER, SUPER + SHIFT, ...) |
| `scroll_desktops_smooth` | bool | `false` |  | the row of desktops follows the wheel continuously (two notches a desktop) and settles on the nearest once the wheel stops; false = a desktop per binds:scroll_desktops_ticks notches |
| `scroll_desktops_ticks` | int | `1` | 1 .. 10 | wheel notches per desktop while binds:scroll_desktops_smooth is off; a notch short shows as a peek toward the next desktop |
| `scroll_desktops_sticky` | bool | `false` |  | after the first desktop of a quick scroll, each further one takes more push (two notches more, or a short dead zone when smooth); let go after 0.4 s still |
| `scroll_desktops_stop_at_empty` | bool | `true` |  | the wheel stops at the first empty desktop past the last one with windows, as the overview does; false = it goes on to 10 or the highest desktop |
| `scroll_desktops_populated_only` | bool | `false` |  | the wheel visits only desktops with windows, the first empty one after them and the one shown; false = every desktop number between |
